falsification_conditions.condition: The price closes above the 200-day moving average by at least 5% within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would indicate a strong bullish trend contradicting the HOLD signal and bottom pattern similarity

falsification_conditions.condition: Trading volume exceeds 200% of the 30-day average volume on three consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained extreme volume would suggest a breakout or blowoff move invalidating the current HOLD position

falsification_conditions.condition: The blowoff score increases to 60 or higher within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A significant rise in blowoff score would indicate a potential top formation, directly contradicting the bottom pattern similarity

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
